video_title: Good Help Is Hard to Find
evidence: SponsorRadar records BRUNT Workwear sponsoring Hunt the Front's August 14, 2026 English-language YouTube video and additional Hunt the Front videos on August 13, August 11, August 10, and August 4, showing repeat current creator spend. Hunt the Front has about 159K subscribers. BRUNT sells tangible work boots and apparel. BRUNT founder/CEO Eric Girouard publicly identified Jeff Newman as Director of Partnerships focused on managing, expanding, and forming brand partnerships; Jeff's current LinkedIn profile remains at BRUNT Workwear and reflects ongoing partnership work.
